messages:
sam_prod: quick flag from a customer demo — the docs call them 'Versions' but the new model panel in the console calls them 'Snapshots'. people got confused which one to pin.

julia_docs: nice catch. where exactly in the model panel? a screenshot would help but i can grep for 'Snapshot' in the console copybase.

sam_prod: header of the right-hand help panel on model detail says 'Snapshots'. also the inline link text reads 'See Versions docs'.

leo_eng: ok that's messy. are 'Snapshot' and 'Version' actually different entities in backend? we shouldn't change copy if there's a technical distinction.

nina_ux: product/design history: 'Snapshot' was an early term for a frozen model artifact, but we standardized on 'Version' in the API months ago. looks like UI missed the rename.

julia_docs: if the canonical term is 'Version' we should make the console use that. docs can include a parenthetical note like "Snapshots (old UI term)" for a short cutoff period.

leo_eng: implementation: console panels build a small help snippet from translations/messages.json. i'll replace the key and add a fallback to map 'snapshot' -> 'version' for search.

nina_ux: UX suggestion: change the panel header to 'Versions' and add a subtle chip next to it: 'formerly Snapshots' that is keyboard-focusable and has an aria-describedby. short tooltip text: 'Snapshots is the legacy name for Versions'.

tom_pm: accessibility check: @a11y-bot can you confirm aria rule for ephemeral chips? also prefer not to open external docs in a new tab without hint.

a11y-bot: accessibility note: chips must be reachable via keyboard; use role="status" only for non-interactive. For the tooltip, use aria-hidden toggles carefully and ensure screen reader reads the relationship. If opening docs, set rel="noopener" and warn users if new tab opens.

julia_docs: docs side: i'll add an anchor #versions and a short header line: "Versions (previously called Snapshots in older console builds)". will also make sure the doc's H1 uses 'Versions' so search favors it.

sam_prod: can we make the in-product link go directly to /docs/models/versions#details rather than a generic search? reduces confusion.

leo_eng: will update the link builder to use DOCS_BASE + "/models/versions#details". adding rel attrs and aria-label as suggested. also will add a small redirect on docs side so /snapshots -> /models/versions for older links.

nina_ux: rollout plan: 1) change console UI copy + chip 2) docs anchor + redirect 3) add in-app search synonym 'snapshot' -> 'versions' 4) add a short banner in release notes. ship copy first so docs changes don't produce a mismatch.

tom_pm: owners: leo for console change (PR today), julia for docs redirect and anchor (EOD), nina for microcopy and banner, sam will update the release notes. target: tomorrow if no blockers.

julia_docs: i'll include a tiny note in docs changelog so customers searching the docs will see the rename. also adding a short redirect rule in CDN config.

leo_eng: pushing branch now `ui/versions-rename`. i'll include tests for the translations fallback and the help-panel link. ping when docs redirect is up so i can switch to canonical link.

a11y-bot: final accessibility reminder: ensure tooltip content is not the only place where the meaning exists; keep primary label 'Versions' clear.

sam_prod: great, thanks team. little UX mismatch but easy fix. will follow up once PRs merge. :white_check_mark:
